_note: The design systems. Each one is a skill folder skills/<id>/ with the same five files (core-director.md, core-graphic.md, talking-head.md, storytelling.md, interview-broll.md; the part of a type file after <!-- graphic --> goes to the motion designer). ready: false = shown as coming soon. sfx: which sound families the engine uses when a scene has no cues of its own.

glossy.name: Glossy
glossy.tagline: Premium clear and liquid glass, crisp depth, cinematic motion
glossy.purpose: Continuous glossy motion graphics: clear and liquid glass cards, crisp splines, glass ribbons, node networks and horizon arcs, every move locked to the voice.
glossy.bestFor: AI, apps, SaaS, money and growth, tech news, premium brands

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.tagline: Calm editorial keynote, tactile white cards, cutless flow
minimal.purpose: Architectural light-grey or graphite grounds with dot/blueprint grids, drifting corner shapes, tactile ceramic & contrast cards, editorial cutouts with single-accent pops, and cutless word-locked motion.
minimal.bestFor: Tips, how-to videos, education, SaaS explainers, finance, editorial storytelling

sound.about: The 4-pass system in Minimal timbre: a soft whoosh opens every scene, word-locked soft textures, a rare impact, a riser and hit only on the hook and the climax, a little under the others.

standard.name: Standard
standard.tagline: Clean solid cards, soft gradients, modern creator & SaaS motion
standard.purpose: Context-driven metaphors rendered with clean solid cards, 3D device showcases, icon docks, split comparisons, bold colour-block switches and cutless word-locked motion over soft gradient grids.
standard.bestFor: Courses, masterclasses, AI & tech promos, everyday creators, agencies, SaaS

sound.about: The 4-pass system in Standard timbre: a whoosh opens every scene, word-locked textures, risers and hits on the hook and the climax.

2d-animation.name: 2D Animation
2d-animation.about: Cartoon films: worlds drawn for each story, ZanHuman people acting with the cartoon kit (engine/cartoon/zc.js). Only for the 2D Animation video type.
